fusions.name: Plague Gnaw
fusions.desc: Spits a bite that deals 4 damage and leaves the target [Diseased] for 1 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Cornered Bite
fusions.desc: Consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to a blow that deals 14 damage. It only strikes a target at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Stowaways
fusions.desc: Takes 0.5 seconds to loose a swarm for 15 seconds that bites an enemy within 6 tiles for 3 damage every second. Each kill you make while it is out restores 4 health.

fusions.name: Last Ones Aboard
fusions.desc: Once your health falls below 30%, you regain 5 health a second for 6 seconds. Once every 60 seconds.
